name.description: The Tailscale/MagicDNS hostname of the service. Required and must be unique.

file.description: The template folder under roles/compose_up/templates/ to render. Defaults to `name` when omitted.

public.description: Whether the service is exposed publicly through the VPS Caddy. Defaults to false.

port.description: Backend port the VPS Caddy reverse-proxies to. Required when public is true; ignored otherwise (private services hardcode their port in their own Caddyfile.j2).

headscale_node.description: Whether the service gets its own Tailscale sidecar / tailnet identity. Defaults to true. Set to false for services that should just publish ports directly (e.g. mqtt).

tls.description: Whether to deploy a local Caddy sidecar for TLS termination. Only relevant when public is false and headscale_node is true. Defaults to true; set to false for private services that don't need TLS (e.g. raw/non-HTTP ports).

tags.description: Headscale ACL tags advertised by the Tailscale sidecar (--advertise-tags). Only meaningful when headscale_node is true.

no_backup.description: Excludes the service from the backup routine.
